name: Gloucester
type: city; unparished area; county town; big city
text: Gloucester ( GLOSS-tər) is a cathedral city, non-metropolitan district and the county town of Gloucestershire in the South West of England. Gloucester lies on the River Severn, between the Cotswolds to the east and the Forest of Dean to the west. It is situated 7 miles (11 km) from Cheltenham, 19 miles (31 km) from Monmouth, 33 miles (53 km) from Bristol, and 17 miles (27 km) east of the England and Wales border.

depictions.name: Gloucester
depictions.text: Gloucester (Old English: Glowecestre) is a city and the county town of Gloucestershire, England.
